visual.general_description: Two-panel brain MRI figure: axial DWI slice (A) and a TOF-MRA projection of intracranial arteries (B).
visual.detailed_description: Landscape black-background composite. Panel A (left half) is a grayscale axial diffusion-weighted brain slice with a prominent bright band lateral to the basal ganglia on the image-left side and a smaller bright focus at the lateral cortex. Panel B (right half) is a MR angiographic projection of the circle of Willis in which the image-left MCA is short with sparse branches while the image-right MCA is longer with more branches; it carries software overlay text (rotation angle and number of views) and viewer arrows. No patient name, ID, date or hospital text is visible in either panel.

panels.general_description: Grayscale axial diffusion-weighted brain MRI slice with panel letter A.
panels.detailed_description: Single axial slice through the frontal lobes, basal ganglia/insular level and posterior hemispheres on a black background, panel letter A at upper left. Marked bright (hyperintense) signal forms a vertically oriented band lateral to the basal ganglia on the image-left side (insular/frontal opercular region) and there is a smaller focal bright spot at the lateral cortical edge on the image-left side posterior to it; the rest of the parenchyma shows mildly heterogeneous, moderately bright signal without other discrete focal bright lesions that can be identified at this resolution. There are no printed left/right markers, arrows, scale bars or text other than the letter A.

panels.general_description: Maximum-intensity-style MR angiogram of the circle of Willis with rotation overlay text and navigation arrows.
panels.detailed_description: Gray-on-black coronal-appearing MR angiographic projection of the intracranial arteries. Both internal carotid arteries ascend as bright vessels at the lower center into the circle of Willis; the anterior communicating/ACA region rises at the top center. On the image-right side a long M1 segment extends laterally with branching distal vessels at the upper right. On the image-left side the M1 segment is short and few distal MCA branches are visible compared with the image-right side, with a few faint small vessels at the left edge. Overlay text on the image reads "Rotation: 9.0 deg." and "Nb Views: 20"; outlined left/right arrows, an up/down arrow and a small white dot are drawn at the upper right as viewer controls; the letter B is printed at the top.

visual.detailed_description: Two-by-two composite. A and B are gray subtraction-style carotid angiograms before and after thrombectomy: A shows sparse MCA-territory filling and B shows restored MCA branches with a rounded arrowed sac. C is a color volume-rendered 3D rotational angiographic reconstruction of the aneurysm with printed measurements 4.7, 4.2 and 7.2 mm. panels.general_description: Anteroposterior-appearing intracranial angiogram before thrombectomy showing the carotid and anterior cerebral circulation with sparse branches on the MCA side.
panels.detailed_description: Gray subtraction-style angiogram with a black frame and the letter A at upper left. A contrast-filled internal carotid artery rises from the bottom center with a curve and reaches the carotid terminus region; from there the anterior cerebral branches ascend along the midline to the top with tortuous distal loops. On the image-left side of the terminus only a short stump and a few small thin vessels are filled, with no large MCA trunk or candelabra of cortical branches visible; the rest of the hemisphere is unfilled. A thin catheter/line-like artifact curves across the lower right. No arrow, text overlay or measurement is present in this panel.
